    • ensureNextAtLeast

      public static void ensureNextAtLeast(int floor)
      Raises the counter to floor if it currently sits lower — never lowers it. Used to keep newly-built places from reusing numbers already on a canvas they're about to join, without disturbing numbers already handed out.
